meta.name: COBOL Insight
defaults_applied: stack.base records base-ui as the schema's classification only; no component library is installed. Modal and the command palette implement the APG dialog pattern by hand (ui/Modal.tsx), and validate_tokens.py rejects null for vite-react.
Tailwind v4 is present for the @theme token layer only; no utility class is written in JSX. The shell keeps its .ci-* classes.

Fonts come from the OS: the app runs offline under a strict CSP with no font host. BIZ UDPGothic ships with Windows 10 and later; Yu Gothic UI and Meiryo are the fallbacks. Code is set in BIZ UDGothic through the project token --font-code in styles/app-tokens.css.

Both themes are authored: color is the light palette and color_dark overrides every key. The .dark class is applied before first paint in main.tsx from the stored override or prefers-color-scheme; the settings file stays the record.
The palettes were authored by hand in OKLCH against the derivation rules in tokens-format.md; the rendered pairings are judged in the review step, not here.

Asset kinds carry no colour of their own: the explorer badge is one muted chip with a codicon glyph per kind. Severity reuses destructive (HIGH), accent (MEDIUM), primary (LOW) and muted_foreground (WARNING).

The light accent, destructive and border values were lowered after the rendered review: 12px amber and red text on the muted ground and 1px control edges were under AA at the first values. The dark border was raised for the same reason.
scale.base_px 14 is the format's floor; dense rows (explorer, problems, status bar) use the 12px step below it.

register 敬体 and katakana_choon smarthr are the defaults; the seed terms are kept because the screens already say 取り込む and 書き出す. 「解析を実行」→「解析」 is added: the product's own verb, and what textlint dict6 asks for.
